purpose: Sequential confirmation lock after the first three randomly selected BTC weeks. No rule or parameter may change before the three locked confirmation weeks are evaluated.

market_logic.structural_cause: A moderately persistent directional metaorder moves price through an already observable micro-auction. A counterflow pullback that retraces part of the impulse without becoming a stronger opposite metaorder transfers inventory. Renewed aggressive flow and a local structure break indicate continuation rather than terminal exhaustion.
market_logic.explicitly_excluded_state: A 90-minute directional move above 6 ATR is terminal-overextension/forced-liquidation risk, not a continuation setup.

market.future_information_policy: Only completed bars and rolling statistics shifted by one completed bar may be used. Entry is the next observed one-minute open.

atr.definition: Median true range of the previous completed 48 five-minute bars

persistent_drift.break_requirement: The drift extreme must break the previously completed 24-bar high or low.

trade.entry: Market at the next one-minute open after the completed five-minute reacceleration bar.
trade.stop: Pullback extreme plus 0.15 ATR beyond the invalidation side.
trade.gap_stop_execution: Worse of stop trigger and one-minute open, then stop slippage and impact.

risk.quantity_rule: Current NAV times 0.03 divided by per-unit expected stop loss including entry and stop fees, entry and stop slippage, market impact and funding allowance.

research_protocol.confirmation_population: All locally available locked BTC weeks excluding the initial three, sorted before random.Random(seed).sample(population, 3).
research_protocol.confirmation_use: Run exactly once without changing code, logic or parameters. Failure rejects or redesigns v5; these weeks may not be used to repair v5.
